name: @serve-tools/server-websocket
description: Typed request and subscription servers over binary WebSockets
author: Jonathan Neal <jonathantneal@hotmail.com> (https://jonneal.dev)

scripts.test: npm run build:dependencies && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:bun: npm run build:dependencies && tsc --project tsconfig.bun.json && bun run test/runtime/bun-conformance.ts
scripts.test:deno: npm run build:dependencies && deno check --sloppy-imports test/runtime/deno-conformance.ts && deno run --sloppy-imports --allow-net test/runtime/deno-conformance.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:dependencies && tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc --project tsconfig.test.json
